versions.changelog:
## Hush 1.0

First release.

- Villagers and wandering traders (idle, yes, no and trading sounds) play at 35 % of their volume, and so do cows, sheep, chickens and pigs.
- Nether portal hum, the portal whoosh and the travel sound play at 25 %.
- Rain plays at 45 %.
- Minecart rolling (outside, inside and underwater) plays at 35 %, anvil use, landing and placing at 40 %.
- No sound is muted, hurt and death sounds are not touched, and every sound keeps its subtitle.

## Hush 1.1

Now also for Minecraft 26.3.

- The same zip works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3; every quieter sound was checked against the sound list of each version.
- Same volumes as in 1.0, nothing changes on 1.21 and 1.21.1.

## Hush 1.2

More everyday sounds are quieter.

- Villager workstation sounds (all 13 professions, including the loud librarian lectern) play at 35 %.
- Goats (bleating and screaming goats) and chickens laying eggs play at 35 %, like the other farm animals.
- Bat squeaks and the bat take-off flutter play at 35 %.
- Bee buzzing and busy beehives play at 40 %; angry bees keep their full warning buzz.
- Furnace, smoker and blast furnace crackling play at 40 %.
- Everything from 1.1 stays as it was. No sound is muted and every sound keeps its subtitle.
- Works on Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3.
